components.text: Each world cell stores nine concentrations: eight elements plus raw Mana. Elements are not one-shot items; they form a field affected by biomes, flow, and array operations.

pages.text:
$(f:minecraft:uniform)WIND  FIRE  WATER  EARTH
LIGHT DARK  SPACE  TIME
MANA = universal magical energy$(/f)
• Wind: motion and speed; Fire: destruction and heat; Water: fluids and wet environments.
• Earth: stability and underground; Light: purification and healing; Dark: void and shadows.
• Space: storage and dimensions; Time: speed and time scale; Mana: the raw input for magic.
